# Elasticsearch

Elasticsearch is a distributed, RESTful search and analytics engine capable of addressing a growing number of use cases. It provides real-time search and analytics for all types of data.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/elasticsearch/.

## Actions

- **Get Index Schema**: Get the complete schema/mapping of a specific elasticsearch index.
- **List Indices**: List all available elasticsearch indices.
- **Query Index**: Query an elasticsearch index with various filters, time ranges, and pagination support.
